CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS.purpose: getMaxConcurrentSubagents() reads the cap (default 20); acquireSubagentSlot() enforces it
acquires/releases a concurrency slot around the agent query loop (try/finally)

CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH.purpose: getMaxSubagentSpawnDepth() reads the cap (default 3); acquireSubagentSlot() enforces it
stamps depth = parent depth + 1 on the subagent context at spawn

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL.purpose: getCustomOpusOption() reads it (3P provider): opus alias resolution + opusplan Plan Mode model ID

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME.purpose: getCustomOpusOption() label = NAME ?? customOpusModel (/model picker Opus display name)

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION.purpose: getCustomOpusOption() description = DESCRIPTION ?? default Custom Opus model (/model picker)

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL.purpose: getCustomSonnetOption() reads it (3P provider): sonnet alias + opusplan non-Plan model ID

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME.purpose: getCustomSonnetOption() label = NAME ?? customSonnetModel (/model picker Sonnet display name)

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTI.purpose: getCustomSonnetOption() description = DESCRIPTION ?? default Custom Sonnet model

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL.purpose: haiku custom option reads it: haiku alias + background functionality model ID

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME.purpose: haiku custom option label = NAME ?? customHaikuModel (/model picker Haiku display name)

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTIO.purpose: haiku custom option description = DESCRIPTION ?? default Custom Haiku model

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION.purpose: getModelOptions():481 pushes a custom /model picker entry for this model ID (does not replace built-in aliases)

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_NAME.purpose: getModelOptions() custom entry label = NAME ?? envCustomModel

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_DESCRIPTIO.purpose: getModelOptions() custom entry description = DESCRIPTION ?? `Custom model (<id>)`

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.purpose: main.tsx:2998 explicitModel = options.model || process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL (global default model)

ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL_AWS_REGION.purpose: overrides AWS region for the Haiku-class model on Bedrock/Mantle
